// idempotent retry const retry = createSales(admin, { tanggal: isoAtWib(today), items: [ { productId: p1!.id, qty: 2 }, { productId: p2!.id, qty: 3 }, ], clientRequestId: "req-batch-1", }); console.log("retry ids sama:", retry.map((t) => t.id).join(",") === res.map((t) => t.id).join(",")); const res2 = createSales(admin, { tanggal: isoAtWib(today), items: [{ productId: p1!.id, qty: 1 }], clientRequestId: "req-batch-2", }); console.log("harga lama:", res[0]!.unitPrice, "harga baru:", res2[0]!.unitPrice); // backdate sebelum harga naik const back = createSales(admin, { tanggal: isoAtWib(yesterday), items: [{ productId: p1!.id, qty: 1 }], clientRequestId: "req-batch-3", }); console.log("backdate unit:", back[0]!.unitPrice, "(harus sama dengan harga lama)"); // duplikat produk ditolak try { createSales(admin, { tanggal: isoAtWib(today), items: [{ productId: p1!.id, qty: 1 }, { productId: p1!.id, qty: 2 }], clientRequestId: "req-batch-4" }); } catch (e) { console.log("duplikat ditolak:", (e as Error).message); } // produk nonaktif ditolak, dan tidak ada yang tertulis const before = getStore().transactions.length; try { createSales(admin, { tanggal: isoAtWib(today), items: [{ productId: p1!.id, qty: 1 }, { productId: state.products.find(p => !p.isActive)!.id, qty: 1 }], clientRequestId: "req-batch-5" }); } catch (e) { console.log("nonaktif ditolak:", (e as Error).message, "| tx bertambah:", getStore().transactions.length - before); } EOF bun ./verify-batch.ts; rm -f ./verify-batch.ts; rm -rf node_modules/server-only)
